fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials and local commentary on Miami civic affairs, including criticism of efforts to suppress negative publicity, discussion of a proposed recall of city commissioners, and coverage of political campaigns and public questions (poll tax, sheriff and governor races). Includes labor-related content such as a statement from the Miami Building Trades Council responding to a prior article about “selling the labor vote,” and commentary on union vote-buying claims. Other pieces address the Chamber of Commerce parade, local vs. outside musicians and bands, school co-education concerns, proposed post office site vs. union station, tourism and hospitality practices, and notices related to Shrine convention decorations and potential fraud. Contains numerous local advertisements and political ads.
